item.title: Only Hindus, Buddhists and Sikhs Can Claim Scheduled Caste Status: Supreme Court
item.description: “No person professing a religion other than Hindu, Sikh or Buddhist can be considered a member of a Scheduled Caste. Conversion to another religion leads to the loss of such status,” the Bench stated.

item.title: Centre Tightens Surveillance as Generic Weight Loss Drugs Hit Indian Markets
item.description: India tightens surveillance on GLP-1 weight-loss drugs as generic semaglutide hits market, warning against misuse and unauthorised sales.

item.title: BCCI Introduces Strict Guidelines for IPL 2026: No Match-Day Practice; Family Members, Friends to Travel Separately
item.description: To maintain broadcast standards and avoid distractions, players and support staff have been barred from sitting directly in front of LED advertising boards during matches.

item.title: “Maybe Me and the Ayatollah”: Trump on Who Will Control the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump says Strait of Hormuz will “be open very soon” and hints at joint control with Iran amid ongoing Middle East conflict and oil supply concerns.

item.title: Moderate Rainfall Forecast for Guwahati; Flash Flood Warning Issued for Key Areas
item.description: The IMD has forecast moderate rainfall across Guwahati and its adjoining areas from March 24 to March 26, raising concerns about possible waterlogging and flash floods in several low-lying localities.

item.title: Assam Makes First Ever Conviction for Possession of Child Pornographic Material Under POCSO Act
item.description: The landmark judgement marks the first of its kind conviction in Assam for storing or possessing child pornography.

item.title: India’s First Passive Euthanasia Case: Harish Rana Dies After 13-Year Coma
item.description: Harish Rana, India’s first passive euthanasia case, dies after 13-year coma as Supreme Court upholds right to die with dignity

item.title: Lok Sabha Passes Transgender Persons Amendment Bill 2026 Amid Opposition Protests
item.description: Lok Sabha passes Transgender Amendment Bill 2026, sparking protests over removal of self-identification and stricter identity rules

item.title: 776 Candidates Cleared to Contest Assam Polls after Scrutiny of Nomination Papers; Decision Pending in Two Seats
item.description: A total of 815 candidates had submitted 1,389 nomination papers for the polls, which are scheduled to be held on April 9. The deadline for withdrawal of candidature is March 26, until 3 pm.

item.title: Iran Allows ‘Non-Hostile’ Ships Through Strait of Hormuz Amid Global Energy Shock
item.description: Iran allows “non-hostile” ships through Strait of Hormuz as conflict disrupts oil supply, sparking fears of global energy price surge

item.title: Singapore State Coroner Rules Zubeen Garg Death Accidental Drowning, No Foul Play
item.description: Addressing concerns raised by Garg’s family, the coroner reiterated that investigations were thorough and found no indication that anyone had forced him into the water or acted with intent to harm.

item.title: Centre Denies Changes to LPG Refill Booking Timelines, Urges Public Not to Panic
item.description: Centre denies changes to LPG refill booking timelines; urges public not to panic and assures adequate LPG stock across the country.

item.title: Rajasthan Royals vs Mumbai Indians Tickets to Go Live Today for Guwahati Clash
item.description: Tickets for all Rajasthan Royals home matches will be available through the District by Zomato app, as well as through physical counters set up at City Center Mall (GS Road), South Point School (Barsapara), and Brahmaputra Riverfront (Uzan Bazar).

item.title: Defending Champions RCB Sold for ₹16,700 Crore in Record-Breaking IPL Deal
item.description: The agreement has been reached with United Spirits Limited, a subsidiary of UK-based Diageo plc for the complete transfer of ownership. The deal will see the consortium take full control, acquiring a 100 percent stake in the Bengaluru-based franchise.

item.title: Government to Hold All-Party Meeting on West Asia Crisis on March 25
item.description: Government calls all-party meeting on West Asia crisis to brief lawmakers amid energy concerns; opposition questions transparency and Rahul Gandhi’s attendance.
